en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an indoor swimming pool with swimmers in the lanes. The pool hall has a flat, low ceiling with repeating square panels, a large wall covered in small rectangular tiles forming an abstract pattern, and an entire long side made of tall grid‑framed windows looking out onto a river or canal and distant buildings. Metal railings line the windows, and there are benches and plants along the poolside. A rectangular sign in German is visible near the windows.
